evidence.title: OpenAI、データセンター立地地域への約束と政策提言を発表 電力費の全額負担や公職者とのNDA不使用など
evidence.body: [e001:f01] OpenAIは、AI向けデータセンター（Compute Campusと呼び方を変更）の建設・運営に関する地域社会への約束と、政府向けの政策提言を発表した。 [e001:f02] 電力や関連インフラ費用の全額負担、公職者との原則的なNDA不使用を盛り込むとともに、大口電力利用者への追加負担など、業界共通のルール作りを政府に求めている。

evidence.title: Jason Adae | 5 Big OpenAI Partner Executive Hires From AWS And Google Cloud
evidence.body: [e002:f01] OpenAI is striving to expand its channel ecosystem and partner go-to-market by hiring some of the biggest channel executives from AWS and Google Cloud. [e002:f02] The AI superstar has hired Google Cloud executives who led the Google Cloud Partner Network and global partner development, while OpenAI has also nabbed AWS executives who led partner sales. [e002:f03] “We’re going to be building this OpenAI partnership with confidence,” Copie said. [e002:f04] CRN breaks down five of the biggest executives that OpenAI has hired over the past several months who are now leading the OpenAI Partner Network and global partner expansion. [e002:f05] Philip Larson Former Position: Google Cloud, Managing Director, Google Cloud Partner Network New OpenAI Position: Senior Director, OpenAI Partner Network Arguably the biggest OpenAI hiring on the channel front over the past few months was Larson. [e002:f06] Before joining OpenAI, Larson was managing director of the Google Cloud Partner Network. [e002:f07] He was instrumental in the creation and launch of Google Cloud’s partner program that went live earlier this year. [e002:f08] Larson is now tasked with leading OpenAI’s Partner Network (OPN) and is responsible for the strategy, design, launch and global operations. [e002:f09] “And excited to work with partners around the world as we build what comes next.” Brian Kane Former Position: Google Cloud, Head Of Global Partner Development New OpenAI Position: Director, Cloud Partnerships Kane has years of top partnership experience working for Google and AWS. [e002:f10] Prior to joining Google Cloud in 2022, Kane was head of global ISV partner management for rival Amazon Web Services for over two years. [e002:f11] Partnerships are a team sport and I’m excited to work with many other individuals across product, engineering, business development, partner marketing, funding and incentives, operations, finance, legal, and more to bring this partnership to our customers.” Ignacio Guillen Former Position: AWS, Senior Leader, Partner Sales, Commercial Accounts New OpenAI Position: Go-To-Market Partner Director Guillen has over a decade of top executive experience working for channel superstars like Google Cloud, AWS and Cisco. [e002:f12] “At AWS, I helped businesses adopt cloud technology,” Guillen said in a LinkedIn post announcing his hiring in October. [e002:f13] Dali Rajic Former Position: Google Cloud’s Wiz, President, COO New OpenAI Position: CRO OpenAI’s new CRO was the former president and COO of security unicorn startup Wiz, which was acquired by Google for $32 billion this year. [e002:f14] Jason Adae Former Position: AWS, Head Of Partner Sales UKI New OpenAI Position: Director, EMEA Partnerships It’s key to know that OpenAI is hiring top talent on a global basis, not just in America, as the company seeks to expand its channel and customer base across the world. [e002:f15] This is why the appointment of Adae, AWS’ former partner sales leader for the U.K. and Ireland, is a big hire. [e002:f16] Adae is responsible for building out OpenAI’s EMEA partnerships, including with vendors like AWS, in the enterprise space.

evidence.title: OpenAIのAIがLinuxカーネルの脆弱性948件を実証、わずか10日間で修正案まで生成
evidence.body: [e003:f01] なぜ重要か: 脆弱性の探索から攻撃の実証、修正案の生成までを自動化した一方、検証対象とは別の脆弱性を悪用する例もあり、原因の特定と人間による審査が欠かせないことが明らかになった。 [e003:f02] 次に見るべき点: 生成された修正案がLinuxカーネルの保守担当者による審査と実環境での検証を経て、どこまで正式な修正として採用・配布されるか。 [e003:f03] OpenAI は2026年11月4日、試作段階のAIシステムを使い、Linuxカーネルで948件のローカル権限昇格の脆弱性を実証し、それぞれの修正案を作成したと 発表した 。 [e003:f04] 10月中旬時点の開発コードを対象とした研究で、脆弱性の探索から攻撃による検証、修正案の生成までを一連の工程として実施した。 [e003:f05] AD 948件の脆弱性はどのように発見・実証されたのか 今回の調査では、低権限の利用者から到達できるコードに対象を絞り、5,034の監査対象に含まれる約 280万 行を分析した。 [e003:f06] これはLinuxカーネル全体の約 7% に相当し、カーネル全体を網羅的に調査した結果ではない。 [e003:f07] 工程 件数 所要時間・検証条件 内容 脆弱性の探索 候補2,308件 12時間 重複を除いた脆弱性の候補 動的検証 再現1,724件 30時間以内、KASANを有効化した隔離VM 実際の実行によって問題を確認 攻撃の実証 攻撃コード1,169本 標準的なLinuxディストリビューションの防御機構を有効にしたVM root権限の取得に成功した攻撃コード 変種の分析・整理 権限昇格の脆弱性948件 異なる948件の修正案を基準に整理 同じ問題の変種を分析・整理した後の件数 この結果はOpenAIが10月中旬に実施した調査に基づくもので、自律的なスキャンと人間による分析を終えるまでには10日間を要した。 [e003:f08] OpenAIは2026年6月にもGPT-5.5 Cyberを使って24件の脆弱性を実証しており、7月下旬のGPT-5.6 Solによる調査では166件に増えていた。 [e003:f09] 今回は探索と動的検証に加えて修正案の生成まで対象を広げ、10月の調査では今後公開予定のサイバーセキュリティ向けモデルを中核に使用している。 [e003:f10] ただし、各調査で対象としたカーネルの開発コードが異なるため、発見件数の増加をそのままAIモデルの性能向上率とみなすことはできない。 [e003:f11] 結果として攻撃そのものは成功していても、指定した脆弱性の悪用可能性を証明したことにはならなかった。 [e003:f12] ただし、修正案の品質が改善したことと、そのすべてがLinuxカーネルの保守担当者に採用されたことは同義ではない。 [e003:f13] AD 948件の修正案は、実際のLinux環境にどこまで届いたのか 10日間の自律スキャンと人間による分析が完了する頃には、OpenAIによると61件が開発元のコードで修正済みとなり、43件は取り込みに向けたパッチの準備段階、299件は公開の報告や議論が進められている段階にあった。 [e003:f14] また、 英国国家サイバーセキュリティセンター （NCSC）が 11月3日に公表した報告書 では、AIによるサイバー攻撃や防御の変化について、2028年を対象とする三つのシナリオを示している。 [e003:f15] すでに実測された変化を示すものでも、OpenAIが報告した948件の脆弱性を独立に検証した結果でもない。 [e003:f16] それでも、AIを使って脆弱性の発見から攻撃の実証、修正案の生成までを大規模に進められることを示した点は重要な成果といえる。

evidence.title: OpenAI announces changes to how it handles data centres amid outcry after US midterms
evidence.body: [e004:f01] This is part of a framework the company believes should be adopted into laws governing the expansion of artificial intelligence. [e004:f02] The series of commitments was released on Thursday (Nov 5). [e004:f03] In a so-called National Community Compact, the company pledges to provide clear data about the [potential community impacts](https:// of issues including noise, water and energy use. [e004:f04] OpenAI also promised to reduce power usage during peak times, send electricity back to the grid and set local hiring goals, assuming the local workforce allows for it. [e004:f05] The AI lab will also publicly report on its progress towards keeping these commitments. [e004:f06] “Households shouldn’t bear the costs of powering data centres,” OpenAI said in the policy document. [e004:f07] “Instead, compute campus investment should help expand and modernise America’s energy grid, strengthen reliability, and deliver broader benefits to consumers.” OpenAI said it had planned the announcement prior to the [election returns](https:// and has been working on it for months. ! [e004:f08] [Image 1: BT Short Logo](blob:http://localhost/a8788ac473293695aa034d3c3a501b44) THE BUSINESS TIMES INSIGHTS Powering Asean's Future 2026 Find out how enterprises are navigating power constraints and sustainability targets ACCESS THE INSIGHTS It combines some measures the AI research lab has already announced in its data centre projects in areas such as Georgia and adds others that stem from conversations with residents and officials in Georgia, Ohio, Texas and other states, said OpenAI’s chief global affairs officer Chris Lehane. [e004:f09] “Certainly a number of them are places that have been particularly impacted by the globalisation of the last 20, 30 years, and for a lot of really good reasons these folks have been really burned by companies and others in the past,” Lehane said. [e004:f10] Voters across the US gave the data centre boom a clear thumbs down on Tuesday night. [e004:f11] Gina Hinojosa, who was elected as the first Democratic governor in Texas in more than three decades, has called for an immediate moratorium on data centre development. [e004:f12] SEE ALSO More Other Democratic gubernatorial victories from Georgia to Ohio and Pennsylvania could leave half of proposed AI data centre additions across the US vulnerable to [stricter local scrutiny and pushback](https:// At least 45 projects valued at US$68 billion were disrupted in some fashion by local opposition in the second quarter of 2026, according to Data Center Watch, a research group. [e004:f13] With data centres becoming increasingly politically unpopular, it is possible some OpenAI projects will be delayed, Lehane said. [e004:f14] “The scale that we are building at there is just going to be a lot of types of things, questions at different levels, state level, local level, that you have to address,” he said. [e004:f15] “If you are going to go into a community and you are going to want to build in that community, you do have to do it with the community and get the community input,” Lehane said. [e004:f16] This is how democracy is supposed to work.” BLOOMBERG。

evidence.title: OpenAI、AIデータセンターの電力コストを地域住民に転嫁せず - 新指針を公表
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 立地する地域に計画への発言権を与え、電力コストなどの負担が住民に及ばないようにするとともに、AIの経済的な恩恵を広く共有することが狙いだ。 [e005:f02] 電力・水・雇用、データセンター立地で3つの約束 Compactは、OpenAIが今後所有・運営するすべてのデータセンターに適用される。 [e005:f03] 地域ごとに個別のCompactを策定し、計画に住民の意見が反映されるよう早い段階から対話する。 [e005:f04] 地元の連絡窓口を設け、取り組み状況を毎年公表する。 [e005:f05] 計画が遅延、縮小、中止された場合に備え、大規模な支出の前に財務面の保証も提供する。 [e005:f06] 2つ目は、地域資源の保護と情報開示で、キャンパスごとの水利用計画や、水と電力の使用量、騒音調査の公表を挙げる。 [e005:f07] 公職者にはNDA(秘密保持契約)を求めず、保護はセキュリティ情報や営業秘密などに限る。 [e005:f08] 3つ目は、地元の労働者や企業への機会づくりで、雇用見込みの公表と、採用や見習い制度の実績の年次報告を行う。 [e005:f09] 具体例として、ジョージア州エフィンガム郡では、住民の意見を反映して480万ドルの助成金を設け、郡内の児童生徒1万4000人全員に無料の給食を提供する。 [e005:f10] オハイオ州パイク郡では、住民が優先課題に挙げた保育のため、OpenAIとSB Energyが共同で600万ドルの拠出を約束した。 [e005:f11] 電力会社には、電力が逼迫した際に安全に需要を削減できるキャンパスの接続を容易にするよう求める。 [e005:f12] 計画中のジョージア州エフィンガム郡のキャンパスでは、Georgia Powerとの契約により、同社が高需要期にOpenAIへの供給を最大1000MW(メガワット)削減できる。 [e005:f13] 州や地方政府が税優遇を与える場合は、条件を公開したうえで、測定可能な約束を盛り込み、開発事業者が果たせなければ優遇分を回収できる仕組みを設けるべきだとも提言している。 [e005:f14] ソノブイ投下とAIによる音響情報処理｜機上センサー(9) アクセスランキング 日本製鉄、2026年度の実力利益予想を7700億円以上に上方修正 USスチールが牽引 2026/11/06 12:18 レポート NTTグループ上期決算まとめ、過去最高収益の7.3兆円 - ドコモ好調もNTTデータは利益46%減 2026/11/06 14:38 レポート KDDI松田社長、モンゴルの大規模草原火災で謝罪 環境回復に取り組む方針 2026/11/06 19:31 レポート KDDI 2026年第2四半期決算は増収増益 - au通信収入とAI事業が成長をけん引 2026/11/06 21:22 レポート 荏原製作所が問い合わせAIチャットの回答精度を20%向上。 [e005:f15] AIが利用ログを分析し改善策を提示 2026/11/05 12:15 レポート ランキングをもっと見る もっと見る 編集部が選ぶ関連記事 半導体 オラクル、Broadcom、SpaceXがAIチップ購入に向け巨額の債務調達を模索 企業動向 S&P、AI投資拡大でハイパースケーラーの信用力低下を警告 - 7兆ドル投資の裏側 半導体 OpenAI、サムスンとの半導体協業を強化 - 次世代チップで共同開発・生産 企業動向 OpenAIアルトマン氏「AI時代はアイデアマンが勝つ」 - 起業環境の変化を語る 電力 AI データセンター OpenAI 関連リンク OpenAI リリース 優先するニュース提供元にマイナビニュースを追加 ※本記事は掲載時点の情報であり、最新のものとは異なる場合があります。 [e005:f16] 新着記事 企業動向 【 厚生労働省 】75歳以上の金融所得を29年から医療費に反映 1時間前 企業動向 【 農林水産省 】武部氏が親子2代で農水相 就任早々に疑惑報道相次ぐ 2026/11/07 11:30 企業動向 KDDI 2026年第2四半期決算は増収増益 - au通信収入とAI事業が成長をけん引 2026/11/06 21:22 レポート 企業動向 newmoとKDDI、堺市で自動運転タクシー商用化に向け連携 - 2028年目指す 2026/11/06 19:45 企業動向 【速報】令和8年度「財界賞経営者賞」決定！

evidence.title: OpenAI responds after Effingham County delays data center vote
evidence.body: [e006:f01] OpenAI says it plans to continue working with Effingham County officials after commissioners delayed a decision on the company's proposed data center for a second time. [e006:f02] In a statement to WJCL News, an OpenAI representative addressed the latest postponement, saying the county commission has the authority to delay the preliminary site plan review. [e006:f03] “The board of commissioners have the authority to defer any preliminary site plan review to a later date based on their bylaws. [e006:f04] OpenAI will continue working closely with county staff and our commissioners to address any outstanding questions and keep the project on schedule.” Why the vote was delayed Effingham County commissioners voted Tuesday, Nov. [e006:f05] 3, to postpone a decision on Project Camellia's site plan until Nov. [e006:f06] The proposed data center has raised concerns among commissioners, particularly about noise protections for nearby neighborhoods and whether the developer's representative was prepared to answer questions about the project. [e006:f07] District 2 Commissioner Roger Burdette questioned the lack of clear commitments about a proposed 20-foot earthen berm that could help reduce noise and light impacts for nearby residents. [e006:f08] County planning staff had recommended approval of the site plan. [e006:f09] Project Camellia is proposed for approximately 1,347 acres within the Savannah Gateway Industrial Hub, along Effingham Parkway and Gateway Parkway. [e006:f10] Plans call for six data center buildings, a warehouse and an operations building. [e006:f11] Commissioners are expected to revisit the site plan during their Nov. [e006:f12] They are also scheduled to discuss a possible data center moratorium and changes to the county's rules for future data center developments.

SoftBank-backed OPay rang the New York Stock Exchange bell, then cancelled its IPO the same day
evidence.body: [e001:f01] On Friday 30th Oc OPay, the Nigeria-focused payments app backed by SoftBank, has cancelled its listing on the New York Stock Exchange. [e001:f02] It was about to raise USD 304 million, or about KES 39.5 billion. [e001:f03] The exchange halted them at 3:30pm. [e001:f04] That evening, OPay told US regulators the offering "will not be completed" because of "a recent regulatory inquiry relating to a jurisdiction immaterial to the Company's business operations". [e001:f05] Nigeria brought in 89.5% of its revenue in the first half of 2026, and the rest of its business is in Indonesia, Egypt and Pakistan. [e001:f06] He's OPay's non-executive chairman and, at 21.3%, its biggest shareholder. [e001:f07] Its prospectus says its Chinese lawyers advised that no filing was needed, because it earned no revenue in mainland China in 2025 and its assets, business and most of its senior managers are outside the country. [e001:f08] It also hasn't explained why China International Capital Corporation, a Chinese investment bank, was one of four lead underwriters in the 23rd October prospectus but isn't in the 30th October pricing announcement. [e001:f09] Underwriters are the banks that buy a company's new shares and resell them to investors, and once OPay and its underwriters agreed to end their deal, the listing was over. [e001:f10] OPay had priced 16 million shares at USD 19 each, about KES 2,500, the bottom of its range and enough to value the company at about USD 4 billion, or about KES 519 billion. [e001:f11] By 2pm they were indicated to open at USD 16.25 to USD 16.75, as the Nasdaq 100 fell 3.5%. [e001:f12] OPay's filing gives only the inquiry as its reason. [e001:f13] SoftBank's Vision Fund 2 led a USD 400 million round in OPay in August 2021, about KES 51.9 billion, at a USD 2 billion valuation, about KES 260 billion. [e001:f14] It was the fund's first investment in an African startup, and a month later we covered it leading Andela's USD 200 million round, about KES 26 billion. [e001:f15] Besides the USD 304 million, a Standard Bank unit had agreed to buy up to USD 200 million (about KES 26 billion) in shares, but only if the listing completed. [e001:f16] You may still remember the name, because Opera launched OPay here in December 2017 as a payment service inside the Opera Mini browser.

evidence.title: SoftBank Corp stock weighs AI investment against financial discipline
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Broader AI financing risks are rising. [e002:f02] Investment now meets capital discipline SoftBank said it invested approximately 200 billion yen in capital expenditures for AI data centers and AI computing infrastructure during the previous plan. [e002:f03] CFO Osamu Akiyama links the next growth phase to broader AI deployment and tighter capital discipline. [e002:f04] Reuters reported wider market concerns about debt-funded AI infrastructure investments and SoftBank Group's credit risk. [e002:f05] SoftBank Corp, JP3732000009, Illustration mit AI erstellt. [e002:f06] SoftBank Corp. is sharpening its AI strategy while emphasizing financial discipline. [e002:f07] In a message published on Friday, November 6, CFO Osamu Akiyama said the company is building on investments in AI data centers and computing infrastructure as it develops its next medium-term plan. [e002:f08] The company's CFO message published by SoftBank said the previous plan exceeded initial forecasts for consolidated revenue, operating income and net income in each fiscal year. [e002:f09] It also said mobile service revenue recovered one year earlier than expected, with PayPay growth supporting the broader business. [e002:f10] The company financed those investments partly through Bond-Type Class Shares while considering financial soundness, according to Akiyama. [e002:f11] For investors, the message frames AI as a long-term growth driver, but also highlights the need to convert technological preparation into operating businesses. [e002:f12] Credit concerns broaden the debate A separate Reuters report said credit-default swap spreads for SoftBank Group reached their highest level in four years as markets questioned the profitability of AI infrastructure investment. [e002:f13] The report concerned SoftBank Group, not SoftBank Corp., but it shows the broader financing pressure surrounding the SoftBank name and AI-heavy investment themes. [e002:f14] The real-time quote of SoftBank Corp stock stood at 1.34 euros on Lang & Schwarz at 10:38 CET on Friday, November 6, 2026. [e002:f15] SoftBank Corp. at a glance Company: SoftBank Corp. evidence.title: ソフトバンクGのCDS保証料率が4年ぶり高水準、AI懸念で株価は一時15％超下落
evidence.body: [e003:f01] ソフトバンクグループの5年物CDSスプレッドが6日、462bpまで上昇し2022年10月以来の高水準となった。 [e003:f02] AI投資の収益性を巡る懸念が背景にあり、同社株も午前の取引で一時9.27％安の3,611円まで下落、寄り付き直後には15.83％安の3,350円を付けた。 [e003:f03] 同社はOpenAIに646億ドル（約10.2兆円）を投じ、半導体設計会社Armの株式約9割を保有する。 [e003:f04] 米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、データセンター開発の減速懸念が信用市場に波及した。 [e003:f05] 人工知能（AI）投資の収益性を巡る懸念が世界の金融市場に広がる中、ソフトバンクグループ（9984.T）のデフォルト（債務不履行）リスクを取引するクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（CDS）市場で6日、保証コストが4年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。 [e003:f06] 株式市場でも同社株が売られ、午前の取引で前日終値比9.27％安の3,611円まで下落した。 [e003:f07] マークイットのデータによると、ソフトバンクGの5年物CDSスプレッドは17.4ベーシスポイント（bp）上昇して462bpとなり、2022年10月以来の水準に達した。 [e003:f08] 市場関係者によれば、一時は466bpまで拡大する場面もあった。 [e003:f09] 野村證券の行情では、同社株は寄り付き直後に3,350円まで急落し、前日終値の3,980円から15.83％下げる場面があった。 [e003:f10] 信用市場と株式市場が同時に反応した背景には、ソフトバンクGのAI関連投資の大きさがある。 [e003:f11] 指標 水準 備考 5年物CDSスプレッド 462bp（+17.4bp） 2022年10月以来の高水準 株価（午前） 3,611円（-9.27％） 一時3,350円まで下落 OpenAI向け投資額 646億ドル（約10.2兆円） — 注：CDSスプレッドはマークイット、株価は野村證券の行情に基づく。 [e003:f12] データセンター整備を主導するために借り入れを重ねてきた企業のCDSスプレッド拡大に拍車がかかっている。 [e003:f13] ソフトバンクGは今年、OpenAIへの投資資金を調達するため記録的な利回りで社債を発行しており、OpenAIが新規株式公開（IPO）の時期を2027年に先送りしたことも、投資回収までの時間軸を市場が読み直す材料となった。 [e003:f14] フューチャラム・グループの半導体・インフラ部門責任者ロルフ・バルク氏は5日の調査リポートで、中間選挙の結果、米国のデータセンター容量の3分の1がリスクにさらされていると分析した。 [e003:f15] 知事が開発を遅らせる可能性のある州に建設予定地が位置しているためだという。 [e003:f16] AI関連の設備投資は、巨額の負債調達を前提とするケースが多く、金利動向や政策変更に対する信用リスクの感応度が高い。

Honda Celebrates 50 Years of Motorcycle Production in Brazil and Announces R$ 3.3 Billion Investment
evidence.body: [e001:f01] As part of the celebrations for this historic milestone and reaffirming its confidence in the growth potential of the Brazilian market, the company announced a new investment cycle for its motorcycle manufacturing operation in Brazil. [e001:f02] The company will invest BRL 3.3 billion from 2026 to 2030 and expand its annual production capacity to 2.3 million motorcycles by 2029, strengthening the competitiveness of its operations and meeting the growing demand of the Brazilian market. [e001:f03] This amount is in addition to the BRL 1.6 billion investment announced last year. [e001:f04] “As we celebrate 50 years of motorcycle production in Brazil, I would like to express my gratitude to all those who made this journey possible. [e001:f05] The announcement was made in the presence of Toshihiro Mibe, President, CEO & Representative Director of Honda Motor Co., Ltd.; Keisuke Tsuruzono, President of Honda South America; members of Honda’s global and local leadership teams; and company associates. [e001:f06] The investment comes amid an expanding motorcycle market in Brazil, driven by consumers’ increasing demand for agile, affordable, and efficient mobility solutions. [e001:f07] Over its 50 years of operation, the plant has produced more than 33 million motorcycles, consolidating Honda’s leadership in the segment and its contribution to the development of Brazil’s manufacturing industry. [e001:f08] Expansion of Production Capacity The investment will enable the construction of two new plants within the manufacturing complex. [e001:f09] Currently, Honda’s Manaus factory operates four assembly lines distributed across two production plants. [e001:f10] With these investments, installed annual production capacity will reach 2.3 million motorcycles by 2029. [e001:f11] Today, the Manaus plant is the most vertically integrated* motorcycle production facility within the Honda Group worldwide, producing approximately 7,200 motorcycles per day. [e001:f12] Honda employs 9,200 associates directly at the Manaus plant and maintains a state-of-the-art Development and Technology Center responsible for product, process, and manufacturing engineering activities. [e001:f13] In addition, the company maintains initiatives focused on environmental sustainability, community development, and road safety through investments in industrial eco-efficiency, safety technologies for its products, and rider education programs delivered through Honda Traffic Education Centers (CETH). [e001:f14] Over the past five decades, Honda has continuously invested in technology, innovation, and professional development, establishing an operation that is recognized globally within the Honda Group. * A vertically integrated facility is one in which most components of the final product are manufactured in-house. [e001:f15] Honda will continue investing in Brazil’s future, contributing to mobility and economic development in local communities. [e001:f16] This investment, aimed at expanding the production capacity of the Manaus factory and strengthening its competitiveness, demonstrates our unwavering confidence in the future of Brazil, the Amazon region, and Honda’s business.

evidence.title: Aston Martin and Glenfiddich Release Limited-Edition 28-Year-Old Single Malt
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The latest bottle from the two British brands spent nearly three decades in casks and reaches the United States and select airports in January 2027. [e004:f02] Apparently, you put it on a whisky bottle. [e004:f03] The whisky goes on sale in January 2027 in the United States and at select international airports. [e004:f04] Neither brand has published pricing or bottle numbers in the material released so far. [e004:f05] A Partnership That Started in Las Vegas The collaboration began at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix in 2024. [e004:f06] Since then, the pair have built a growing collection of limited-edition bottles, and this 28-year-old release is the newest addition. [e004:f07] Car makers have long lent their badges to lifestyle products, and Aston Martin frames this one around shared British heritage. [e004:f08] Glenfiddich Malt Master Brian Kinsman combined several oak influences to shape the final whisky. [e004:f09] According to the distillery, that second stage brings out vanilla and spice. [e004:f10] Traditional ex-bourbon casks bring the orchard fruit notes Glenfiddich is known for. [e004:f11] Podium Green and Copper Aston Martin’s design team worked with Glenfiddich on the packaging. [e004:f12] The brands say the design draws on the flowing bodywork of Aston Martin’s supercars and hypercars. [e004:f13] When this whisky first went into casks in the late 1990s, Aston Martin was developing Project Vantage, the concept that eventually became the Vanquish. [e004:f14] So the liquid started ageing just as Aston Martin was shaping the car that would open its next chapter. [e004:f15] Still, it shows how Aston Martin uses its British identity, and the F1 stage where this partnership began, to reach people well beyond the showroom. [e004:f16] For collectors, the 28-year age statement is the main appeal.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e005:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e005:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e005:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e005:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e005:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e005:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e005:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e005:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e005:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e005:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: New Honda Avancier with next-gen hybrid system teased; global launch expected in 2027
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Honda has teased the 2027 Avancier, a flagship seven-seater hybrid SUV expected to debut in Thailand. [e006:f02] It will feature a new hybrid system and distinctive LED styling Japanese automaker Honda is doubling down on its sustainability strategy across the globe. [e006:f03] The company recently introduced its flagship hybrid SUV, the ZR-V, in India. [e006:f04] However, the global market is set to get a new flagship SUV in the form of the new Avancier, which Honda recently teased across its social media platforms. [e006:f05] It is expected to be a seven-seater SUV, which will be positioned above the CR-V, expected to compete against the likes of the Hyundai Santa Fe and Kia Sorento globally. [e006:f06] The Honda Avancier is a C-segment SUV that has been sold in India’s neighbouring country, China, from 2016 onwards. [e006:f07] However, the model that the Japanese automaker is set to launch is going to be very different from the model being sold in China. [e006:f08] Additionally, the 2027 Honda Avancier is expected to be manufactured in Thailand. [e006:f09] Not only that, but the Avancier SUV will debut Honda’s completely new hybrid system, replacing the older ‘e:HEV’ system, which powers the City hybrid as well as the ZR-V that are currently available in the Indian market. [e006:f10] The company has not unveiled any information about the engine, battery pack, specifications, range figures and performance figures. [e006:f11] The upcoming Honda Avancier is expected to be Honda's flagship SUV globally, especially in Southeast Asia and the Oceania region. [e006:f12] Honda has not yet revealed whether the Avancier would be India-bound. [e006:f13] However, the arrival of the Kia Sorento in India can lead the Japanese automaker to deliberate on the Avancier's India launch. [e006:f14] Honda Avancier: Exterior Details Teased The full-size upcoming SUV boasts wraparound LED headlamps, with welcome and goodbye animations. [e006:f15] At the rear, it features a connected LED taillamp with two vertical lamps on either side, giving it an H-shaped look. [e006:f16] Moreover, the rear gets an integrated spoiler along with the new Honda logo on the tailgate and the ‘Avancier’ lettering placed under the logo.

[e002:f09] Currently, Honda’s Manaus factory operates four assembly lines distributed across two production plants. [e002:f10] With these investments, installed annual production capacity will reach 2.3 million motorcycles by 2029. [e002:f11] Today, the Manaus plant is the most vertically integrated* motorcycle production facility within the Honda Group worldwide, producing approximately 7,200 motorcycles per day. [e002:f12] Honda employs 9,200 associates directly at the Manaus plant and maintains a state-of-the-art Development and Technology Center responsible for product, process, and manufacturing engineering activities. [e002:f13] In addition, the company maintains initiatives focused on environmental sustainability, community development, and road safety through investments in industrial eco-efficiency, safety technologies for its products, and rider education programs delivered through Honda Traffic Education Centers (CETH). [e002:f14] Over the past five decades, Honda has continuously invested in technology, innovation, and professional development, establishing an operation that is recognized globally within the Honda Group. * A vertically integrated facility is one in which most components of the final product are manufactured in-house. [e002:f15] Honda will continue investing in Brazil’s future, contributing to mobility and economic development in local communities. [e002:f16] This investment, aimed at expanding the production capacity of the Manaus factory and strengthening its competitiveness, demonstrates our unwavering confidence in the future of Brazil, the Amazon region, and Honda’s business.

evidence.title: Aston Martin and Glenfiddich Release Limited-Edition 28-Year-Old Single Malt
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The latest bottle from the two British brands spent nearly three decades in casks and reaches the United States and select airports in January 2027. [e004:f02] Apparently, you put it on a whisky bottle. [e004:f03] The whisky goes on sale in January 2027 in the United States and at select international airports. [e004:f04] Neither brand has published pricing or bottle numbers in the material released so far. [e004:f05] A Partnership That Started in Las Vegas The collaboration began at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix in 2024. [e004:f06] Since then, the pair have built a growing collection of limited-edition bottles, and this 28-year-old release is the newest addition. [e004:f07] Car makers have long lent their badges to lifestyle products, and Aston Martin frames this one around shared British heritage. [e004:f08] Glenfiddich Malt Master Brian Kinsman combined several oak influences to shape the final whisky. [e004:f09] According to the distillery, that second stage brings out vanilla and spice. [e004:f10] Traditional ex-bourbon casks bring the orchard fruit notes Glenfiddich is known for. [e004:f11] Podium Green and Copper Aston Martin’s design team worked with Glenfiddich on the packaging. [e004:f12] The brands say the design draws on the flowing bodywork of Aston Martin’s supercars and hypercars. [e004:f13] When this whisky first went into casks in the late 1990s, Aston Martin was developing Project Vantage, the concept that eventually became the Vanquish. [e004:f14] So the liquid started ageing just as Aston Martin was shaping the car that would open its next chapter. [e004:f15] Still, it shows how Aston Martin uses its British identity, and the F1 stage where this partnership began, to reach people well beyond the showroom. [e004:f16] For collectors, the 28-year age statement is the main appeal.

evidence.title: Herta reaches 40 points at Interlagos after Mexico tally error delayed his F1 bid
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Colton Herta needed 24 laps in Sergio Pérez’s Cadillac at Interlagos. [e005:f02] He completed 31 to reach the 40-point threshold and become eligible to apply for a full FIA super licence. [e005:f03] News Summary Colton Herta earned his 40th super licence point in São Paulo Grand Prix FP1 after completing 31 laps in Sergio Pérez’s Cadillac. [e005:f04] The American had arrived on 39 points after a correction to his 2025 IndyCar finishing position left him one short following practice in Mexico City. [e005:f05] Reaching 40 points clears the points requirement for Herta to apply for a full FIA super licence. [e005:f06] Cadillac has yet to announce him as a race driver for 2027. [e005:f07] Colton Herta earned the final point he needed to qualify for a full FIA Formula 1 super licence in opening practice for the São Paulo Grand Prix on Friday. [e005:f08] The Cadillac reserve driver completed 31 laps at Interlagos in Sergio Pérez’s car, clearing the 100km requirement and taking his tally from 39 to 40. [e005:f09] He completed the required running after the restart and finished 20th with a best lap of 1:14.275. [e005:f10] Colton Herta (Photo: Rodrigo Berton/Agência WarmUp) Why Herta still needed a point after Mexico Herta had already covered the required distance in Mexico City, completing 30 laps in FP1. [e005:f11] IndyCar’s published standings had listed him sixth in the 2025 championship, but he was seventh on countback after finishing level on points with Felix Rosenqvist. [e005:f12] Rosenqvist had more second-place finishes. [e005:f13] The correction left him on 39 even after the point from Mexico , giving Cadillac a reason to put him back in the car one week later. [e005:f14] As GRANDE PRÊMIO detailed before his Interlagos outing , Herta arrived in Brazil with 35 points from his IndyCar results and four from eligible F1 practice appearances. [e005:f15] What reaching 40 points means for Herta’s Cadillac prospects Herta can now apply for the full FIA super licence required to race in Formula 1. [e005:f16] GRANDE PRÊMIO is following every session of the São Paulo Grand Prix live from Interlagos in Formula 1 .

evidence.title: 【FP2結果】ホンダ勢苦戦 ルクレールへの進路妨害疑いでカマラ審議へ、新王者アントネッリが最速！／F1サンパウロGP
evidence.body: [e008:f01] ／F1サンパウロGP 11/7(土) 6:53 配信 2026年F1サンパウロGP、新王者アンドレア・キミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス）(C)Pirelli（TopNews） 11月6日(金)、2026年F1第20戦サンパウロGP（アウトドローモ・ホセ・カルロス・パーチェ）の1日目、フリー走行2が開催された。 [e008:f02] ■【結果】フリー走行2：F1サンパウロGP 1 アンドレア・キミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス） 2 ランド・ノリス（マクラーレン／メルセデス） 3 マックス・フェルスタッペン（レッドブル／フォード） 4 ジョージ・ラッセル（メルセデス） 5 オスカー・ピアストリ（マクラーレン／メルセデス） 6 ルイス・ハミルトン（フェラーリ） 7 シャルル・ルクレール（フェラーリ） 8 ガブリエル・ボルトレト（アウディ） 9 イザック・ハジャー（レッドブル／フォード） 10 オリバー・ベアマン（ハース／フェラーリ） 11 フランコ・コラピント（アルピーヌ／メルセデス） 12 アービッド・リンドブラッド（レーシングブルズ／フォード） 13 リアム・ローソン（レーシングブルズ／フォード） 14 ピエール・ガスリー（アルピーヌ／メルセデス） 15 フェルナンド・アロンソ（アストンマーティン／ホンダ） 16 ラファエル・カマラ*（ハース／フェラーリ） 17 カルロス・サインツ（ウィリアムズ／メルセデス） 18 ランス・ストロール（アストンマーティン／ホンダ） 19 アレクサンダー・アルボン（ウィリアムズ／メルセデス） 20 セルジオ・ペレス（キャデラック／フェラーリ） 21 バルテリ・ボッタス（キャデラック／フェラーリ） 22 ニコ・ヒュルケンベルグ（アウディ） 【関連リンク】 ●【F1ライブ結果速報】F1サンパウロGPも全セッションライブでお届け ●【FP2タイム差】新王者アントネッリ最速！ [e008:f03] ■アストンマーティン・ホンダ ホンダのパワーユニットを搭載するアストンマーティン・アラムコF1チームは、フェルナンド・アロンソが15番手、ランス・ストロールは18番手だった。 [e008:f04] ■トピックス ・気温20℃、路面温度34℃、湿度87％のドライコンディション。 [e008:f05] アウディのヒュルケンベルグはFP1のトラブルの影響で走行できず。 [e008:f06] 各車はハード、ミディアムで走行を開始。 [e008:f07] ・マクラーレンはアップデートを投入。 [e008:f08] ハミルトンは「何が悪いのか全く分からない」と苦戦を訴える。 [e008:f09] ・ペレス、ラッセル、アントネッリが相次いでコースアウト。 [e008:f10] ・雨を警戒して各車がソフトでタイムアタックを開始。 [e008:f11] ・ルクレールはカマラに進路を妨害され、ウォール側へ追いやられる。 [e008:f12] ターン15での走行妨害として記録された。 [e008:f13] ・ルクレールはストレートでのタイムロスを指摘され、エンジンの状態をチームに確認。 [e008:f14] ・ガスリーはペースが上がらず、FP1で代走したミニの好タイムとは対照的な走行となった。 [e008:f15] ホンダ勢は苦戦、ハミルトンも苦悩 雨粒と相次ぐコースアウト／F1サンパウロGP ●【FP1タイム差】ノリス最速！ [e008:f16] 新王者アントネッリ2番手、フェルスタッペン3番手もステアリングに異変 赤旗中断の波乱も／F1サンパウロGP ●ホンダの2027年型F1エンジンはすでに試験中 アロンソは来季に自信 ●アントネッリのF1初王座でフェラーリ移籍を望む声が再燃 ウォルフ代表は9年間の育成を強調。
